messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to pick a canonical config API for console + runtime. Current split between /v1/flags (console) and /v2/runtime (service) is causing surprise rollouts.
sara: Agreed. Can we list the main pain points? I keep seeing mismatched scope, different TTL semantics, and no single preview path.
mike: +1. Also telemetry: we don't have a standard 'preview' mode that emits evaluation telemetry without flipping the live rule.
jordan: Proposal: one config-service as source-of-truth. Console edits write a draft (preview) that can be validated, previewed against routing calc, and then promoted. API should expose: PATCH /configs/:id/draft, POST /configs/:id/validate, POST /configs/:id/promote.
pm-ash: We also need rollout primitives in that schema: percent (0-100), cohort strategy, and a safety window. UX should show expected QPS impact and estimated latency delta.
alex: UX + API should agree on semantics for "percent" (hash-based cohort vs random bucket). We must avoid console saying 10% but server doing sticky buckets differently.
mike: Telemetry gating: validation should kick off a shadow eval run for X minutes and publish eval metrics to the draft's telemetry namespace. Only allow promote when regressions < threshold.
sara: How would teams consume shadow evals? We need per-draft metric dashboards and an alerting hook.
jordan: Minimal MVP: store a draft_id, run a shadow runner that samples real traffic at configured sample_rate, emit metrics under telemetry.drafts.<draft_id>.

mike: Example config snippet we discussed:

```
PATCH /configs/feature-redistribution/draft
{
  "rules": [
    { "cohort": "hash(user_id)", "percent": 10, "variant": "new-routing" }
  ],
  "safety_window_minutes": 30,
  "shadow_sample_rate": 0.01
}
```

alex: Console should show: estimated tokens/sec, expected additional GPU concurrency, and "shadow traffic used" count.
pm-ash: Ops constraints: when promoting to global we should support a dry-run toggle that flips only a small region or specific project IDs first.
sara: What about backwards compatibility? Some services still call /v1/flags. We should provide a compatibility shim that translates v1 to canonical config internally.

jordan: Internals: store canonical config as proto with fields: id, versions[], draft{json}, rollouts[], telemetry_refs[]. Then provide translation layers to older endpoints.
mike: Also add an "abort on error" safety signal: if any live metric breaches threshold during rollout, auto-revert to previous version and fire webhook.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note — canary-runner currently supports shadow sampling; will need API extension to accept draft_id and sample_rate. :white_check_mark:

alex: Action items:
- jordon: write a short RFC describing canonical schema + promo flow (due EOD Wed)
- mike: prototype shadow-eval telemetry namespacing and revert hooks (sync Thu)
- sara: wire a minimal draft UI mock showing preview metrics (sync Fri)
- pm-ash: confirm rollback SLAs and webhook contract with SRE

sara: Sounds good. One more ask — include a visible ETag / change-id on draft preview so service teams can pin a draft for their integration tests.
jordan: Will add. :thumbsup:
mike: If nobody objects, I'll start prototyping the validation endpoint and sample runner.
alex: No objections from me. Thanks everyone, we'll iterate on the RFC.
